flow.name: Travel Agency WhatsApp Assistant
flow.description: Deterministic menu-driven travel assistant for trip planning, packages, flights, hotels, bookings, travel services, support, and human handoff.

config.text:
👋 Welcome to [Travel Agency Name]! ✈️🌍

We're here to help you plan your journey and assist with all your travel needs.
How can we help you today?
✈️ What would you like help with?
What type of trip are you planning?
Do you already have a destination in mind?

config.prompt_text:
Great! Which destination(s) would you like to visit?

Example: Switzerland, Paris and Italy
✈️ Which city or airport will you be travelling from?

config.text: 📅 When are you planning to travel?

config.prompt_text:
Please provide your preferred departure and return dates.

Example: 10 December 2026 to 20 December 2026
Which month or approximate period are you planning to travel?
⏳ How long would you like your trip to be?

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Please tell us who will be travelling.

Mention the number of adults, children, and ages of children if applicable.

Example: 2 adults and 2 children aged 5 and 8
💰 What is your approximate trip budget?
🏨 What type of accommodation do you prefer?

🎯 What would you like to experience during your trip?

Examples: Beaches, Nature, Sightseeing, Theme Parks, Shopping, Culture, Adventure, Food Experiences

✨ Do you have any special requirements?

Examples: Direct flights, vegetarian meals, child-friendly hotels, wheelchair accessibility, anniversary celebration.

Type No if none.

config.text:

We have received your travel requirements. Our travel expert will review your request and get back to you with suitable options. ✈️🌍
